track.title: 英语不再先翻译：年轻人的 30 天生活口语
track.description: 用真实场景短练和开口跟练，从只会看懂走到能回应、能继续、卡住时也能修复对话。
track.goalStatement: 能够在常见生活、旅行、社交和工作场景中完成简短连续对话，并在听不懂或忘词时主动澄清和换一种说法。
track.goalReason: 解决学过多年英语但真实场景中先逐字翻译、回应过慢、害怕犯错和一听不懂就停止交流的问题。
track.targetUserDescription: 18～30岁，掌握基础英语词汇和句型，大致处于A2至B1水平，但缺少真实开口经验的年轻人。
track.requirements: 能够阅读基础英文短句；建议每周练习5次，每次5～15分钟。无需追求特定口音。

states.title: 能看懂但开口迟疑
states.description: 熟悉常见词句，却经常先逐字翻译或因担心错误而错过回应时机。

criteria.description: 能理解常见生活场景中的基础问题
面对即时回应时常出现明显停顿或回避

states.title: 能快速调用常用表达
states.description: 能够用短句和常用表达块完成请求、确认、感谢、拒绝等核心意图。

criteria.description: 能在十秒内对五类熟悉场景说出一句清楚回应
能根据关系和场景选择基本合适的语气

states.title: 能完成三轮对话
states.description: 不只回答一句，还能用追问、确认或补充信息让对话继续。

criteria.description: 能完成提问、回应和确认构成的三轮对话
能围绕同一场景补充至少一条相关信息

states.title: 卡住时能修复交流
states.description: 听不清、没理解或忘词时，能够请求重复、放慢、确认或换词解释。

criteria.description: 能使用至少三种修复句应对不同卡点
小错误不影响意思时能够继续交流

states.title: 能完成两分钟场景交流
states.description: 能够围绕常见场景清楚表达意图、补充信息、回应追问并自然收束。

criteria.description: 能围绕一个熟悉场景连续表达约两分钟
能根据对方回应调整表达并保持语气合适

concepts.name: 听不懂或说不出时的修复策略
围绕真实意图完成表达

exercises.title: 第一反应：这句话怎么接
exercises.userRequest: 选择简洁、自然并能完成当前意图的英语回应。

questions.questionContent: At a café, the staff asks, ‘For here or to go?’ You want to take the drink away. What is the most natural reply?
questions.explanation: ‘To go, please’直接回答堂食还是外带，简洁且礼貌。
questions.testableClaim: 能对常见服务场景作出简洁自然的即时回应

questions.questionContent: A colleague says, ‘Can we move the meeting to three?’ You are available. What is the best reply?
questions.explanation: ‘Three works for me’自然地表示三点可以。

questions.questionContent: Someone introduces themselves at an event. Which reply helps the conversation continue?
questions.explanation: 回应姓名并询问对方如何得知活动，既自然又能继续交流。
questions.testableClaim: 能在回应后增加一个相关问题推动对话

options.content: Nice to meet you. How did you hear about this event?

questions.questionContent: In most everyday situations, a short clear sentence can be more useful than a long sentence translated word by word from Chinese.
questions.explanation: 正确。口语首先要让对方理解意图；短句和常用表达块更容易及时调用。
questions.testableClaim: 理解真实口语优先清楚和合适，而非逐字翻译与句子长度

questions.questionContent: You are five minutes late to meet a friend. Write one or two natural English sentences to apologize and give a brief reason.
questions.explanation: 评分依据：①明确道歉；②简短说明而非冗长辩解；③语气适合朋友；④小错误不影响理解即可。示例：Sorry I’m a few minutes late. The bus was slower than usual.
questions.testableClaim: 能在迟到场景中完成道歉和简短说明

stateLink.whyNow: 先判断当前主要困难是词句不足、语气不合还是回应过慢。

exercises.title: 对话卡住了怎么办
exercises.userRequest: 练习请求重复、确认关键信息和忘词时换一种说法。

questions.questionContent: You did not hear the last part of a station announcement. What should you say?
questions.explanation: 该表达礼貌说明没听清，并请求重复，是最直接的修复策略。
questions.testableClaim: 能请求对方重复没有听清的信息

options.content: Could you say the last part again, please?

questions.questionContent: You know what you mean but forget the word ‘charger’. Which strategy is best?
questions.explanation: 用‘给手机充电用的东西’描述功能，可以让对方帮助补词并继续交流。
questions.testableClaim: 能在忘词时用功能或外形换一种说法

options.content: Say a random Chinese word louder.
Describe it as ‘the thing I use to charge my phone’.
Pretend you do not need it.

questions.questionContent: Which sentences can help you confirm information you may have misunderstood?
questions.explanation: 复述时间和询问理解是否正确都能降低误解；直接假定和回避不会完成核实。
questions.testableClaim: 能使用复述和确认句核对关键信息

options.content: So we meet at the east entrance at six, right?
If I understood correctly, I should email it today.
I’ll just assume it is tomorrow.
It doesn’t matter what you said.

questions.questionContent: If you make a small grammar mistake, the safest response is always to stop the conversation and start the whole sentence again.
questions.explanation: 错误。若意思清楚，可以继续；只有错误影响关键信息时，才需要简短更正。
questions.testableClaim: 理解小错误不影响意思时可以继续表达

questions.questionContent: A hotel receptionist speaks too quickly. Write two sentences: first ask them to slow down, then confirm the check-out time is eleven.
questions.explanation: 评分依据：①礼貌请求放慢；②明确复述十一点退房；③两句话意思清楚。示例：Could you speak a little more slowly, please? So check-out is at eleven, right?
questions.testableClaim: 能组合请求放慢语速与复述确认

stateLink.whyNow: 掌握修复策略后，不必等到每句话完美才敢继续。

exercises.title: 三轮对话与真实场景表达
exercises.userRequest: 在餐饮、工作、社交和问路场景中完成连续表达。

questions.questionContent: At a restaurant, your dish contains peanuts, but you told the staff you cannot eat them. Write two or three clear sentences to explain the problem and ask for help.
questions.explanation: 评分依据：说明菜里有花生、提到此前的饮食限制、提出更换或确认安全处理的请求；不要求复杂词汇。示例：Excuse me, this dish has peanuts. I mentioned that I can’t eat them. Could you please check and replace it with a safe option?
questions.testableClaim: 能在餐饮问题中说明事实并提出明确请求

questions.questionContent: You disagree with a teammate’s plan but want to keep the discussion constructive. Write one or two sentences that show your concern and invite comparison.
questions.explanation: 评分依据：①不是直接否定对方；②指出一个具体担忧；③邀请比较或讨论。示例：I see the advantage, but I’m worried about the deadline. Could we compare it with the shorter option?
questions.testableClaim: 能以合作语气表达不同意见

questions.questionContent: You need to end a friendly conversation because your train is arriving. Which sentence is most natural?
questions.explanation: 先说明需要离开，再表达交流愉快，语气自然。
questions.testableClaim: 能礼貌而清楚地结束对话

options.content: I have to catch my train, but it was great talking with you.

questions.questionContent: A useful two-minute self-introduction at a community event may include which elements?
questions.explanation: 姓名、来意和一个可继续聊的兴趣足够形成自然入口；身份证号和完整住址不应分享。
questions.testableClaim: 能选择支持继续交流的自我介绍信息

options.content: Your name and why you came
One relevant interest or recent activity

questions.questionContent: Write a three-turn mini-dialogue in English. Situation: you ask a stranger for directions, they answer, and you confirm whether the place is within walking distance.
questions.explanation: 评分依据：①包含礼貌问路；②对方回答与地点相关；③最后确认步行距离；④三轮逻辑连续。示例：A: Excuse me, how can I get to the city library? B: Go straight and turn left at the bank. A: Thanks. Is it close enough to walk?
questions.testableClaim: 能完成提问、回应和确认构成的连续三轮对话

stateLink.whyNow: 综合检查信息、语气、连续性和修复能力。

actions.title: 每日一个英语情境快问答
actions.description: 每天完成一个 A2–B1 难度的真实生活或工作表达题，接受多种正确说法，重点看意思、语气和能否继续交流。

stateLink.whyNow: 用短而频繁的情境练习提高即时调用速度。

generatedContentConfig.instruction: 为18至30岁、具备基础英语但开口迟疑的用户生成一组A2-B1生活英语快问答。每批围绕一个场景，轮换餐饮、出行、旅行、社交、工作协作、求助、确认和礼貌拒绝，避免近期重复。每题要求用户选择或写1至2句自然英文；干扰项来自逐字翻译、语气不合或信息不完整。答案接受多种表达，解释关键词、语气和对话下一步，不因小拼写错误直接判错。不使用罕见俚语、文化刻板印象或需要地区最新信息的题目。

actions.title: 十个场景开口跟练
actions.description: 从关键表达、替换信息、三轮对话到一分钟自由表达，逐步完成十类常见英语场景。

stateLink.whyNow: 把题目中的表达迁移到连续口头交流。

levels.title: 快速说出一句
levels.description: 看到场景后用一个常用表达完成核心意图。
levels.promotionCriterion: 五类熟悉场景能在十秒内说出一句清楚表达

contentBlocks.textContent: 从请求、确认、感谢、拒绝中选一个意图，先说最短可用的一句，不逐字翻译。

levels.title: 替换关键信息
levels.description: 在同一句型中替换时间、地点、人物和需求。
levels.promotionCriterion: 能连续完成三次信息替换且意思保持清楚

contentBlocks.textContent: 选一个常用表达，分别替换时间、地点和具体请求；每次完整说出一句。

levels.title: 完成三轮对话
levels.description: 提问、回应并用确认或追问继续交流。
levels.promotionCriterion: 六个场景都能完成逻辑连续的三轮对话

contentBlocks.textContent: 先说出目的，想象对方的一句回应，再补一个确认或追问。卡住时使用请求重复或换词说明。

levels.title: 处理听不懂和忘词
levels.description: 主动请求放慢、重复、确认或用功能描述忘记的词。
levels.promotionCriterion: 遇到三类卡点都能使用合适的修复句继续交流

contentBlocks.textContent: 故意选一个容易忘词的场景，不查词，先用‘the thing that…’描述，再补一句确认。

levels.title: 一分钟场景表达
levels.description: 围绕一个真实场景连续表达约一分钟。
levels.promotionCriterion: 能完成开头、核心信息、一个补充和自然收束

contentBlocks.textContent: 从自我介绍、说明计划、描述问题或表达观点中选一个，先列四个关键词，再连续说约一分钟。

checkpoints.title: 真实场景表达检查
checkpoints.description: 确认表达清楚、语气适合，并能在卡住时继续。
